test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BREWING' is written as 'CIFDJMH' and 'ANCIENT' is written as 'BMDRFMU'. How will 'MUSEUMS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**'BREWING' is written as 'CIFDJMH',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a916d5508b65e486cc60de6e4eb2ba6ba4c5be67619fa5d84e3461d32fa30b32.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b711f42a4d19ca01350057017e8efea284cbf09583d49be089b01e841a8c4b7a.png] 

**'ANCIENT' is written as 'BMDRFMU',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20e04f0bba53c18e96f083b774b4e29aeeda0a42190b52074c4da47dd6ec66fe.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0db3b9cb2c588ad5d2371628505b7e68f3779e88ff7d4f817b9a7700907e350c.png] 

Similarly,

**'MUSEUMS' can be coded as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e4c9500b9982186324a4f41c09531b3220fe0ba827eccebb2f16cc8799c90c5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517f9f935f93267984af5a194b590bf5dbd8ca12d5aa7e413f5edb485711440e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****NFTVVNT"**.
